narrative: Middle-earth is threatened by Sauron, a dark lord seeking the One Ring—a cursed golden ring that grants immense power and corrupts anyone who carries it. Two hobbits are traveling across the barren volcanic wasteland of Mordor toward Mount Doom, the only fire where the Ring can be destroyed.
rules: The One Ring can only be destroyed by throwing it into the fires of Mount Doom.
Carrying the One Ring drains the bearer's physical strength and slowly twists their mind with paranoia and obsession.
Hobbits are small, resilient folk who are naturally resistant to the Ring's corruption, though not immune.

places.name: Mordor
places.desc: A barren volcanic wasteland ruled by Sauron and crawling with orcs.

places.name: Mount Doom
places.desc: The volcano where the One Ring was forged and the only place it can be destroyed.
